capabilities: Search active and archived OpenSpec changes by title, folder name or main repository
Preview task checkmarks and specification changes before archiving
Archive a change and sync the selected tasks and specs
Update the archive note and affected Markdown links
Resume an unfinished archive document update
disambiguation: Not a spec editor; it browses, previews and archives existing OpenSpec changes.
extras: Windows desktop only, with a Simplified Chinese interface. Previews run the CLI on copies in the system temporary directory, which are removed afterwards; OpenSpec CLI telemetry is disabled. An optional Xrzc index adaptation also reads the parent project's HANDOFF.MD and docs/ Markdown files when the vault opens openspec/ directly.
problem: Archiving an OpenSpec change by hand means editing task checkmarks, spec files, archive notes and links across the vault with no preview of the result.

relations.evidence: runs a separately installed local OpenSpec CLI from the project root

summary: Panel that browses, previews and archives OpenSpec CLI changes, syncing selected task checkmarks, spec edits and affected links into the vault.
